superseded_selection.reason: A smaller foundational integration gap with direct static causal evidence was not included in the comparative leverage decision.

static_causal_chain: capability_discovery full-metadata route emits binding_kind=apt and discovery_source=APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN.
auto_capability_acquisition._discovery_supplier_order reads binding_kind before discovery_source and maps apt to apt_cli, so the verified candidates reach the APT supplier class.
auto_apt_cli_acquisition._viable_candidates discards every candidate whose discovery_source is not exactly APT_CATALOG.
Therefore APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN candidates are deterministically removed before apt_cli_probe or cli_contract_inference can run on the faithful full-metadata route.

secondary_uncertainty.finding: No preserved calibration evidence justifies transferring the legacy handcrafted-score absolute threshold to Xapian BM25 weights. Treat the threshold as unvalidated for the new source, not as a proven portable contract.

why_this_precedes_multi_tool_orchestrati: The defect is a narrow interface seam between two already-built generic components, so time to a decisive fix/test is low.
It blocks the existing autonomous discover-to-acquire-to-contract-to-execute path, so capability gain is direct rather than speculative.
Dynamic tool acquisition is an upstream enabler for later multi-tool orchestration, giving the repair multi-capability leverage.
PR111 requires a new frontier bar and fresh compound-work adjudication; this seam is already causally localized.

minimum_repair_shape: Use stable APT binding/evidence properties for candidate admission rather than a discovery-source-name whitelist.
Do not apply an uncalibrated legacy absolute score threshold to Xapian candidates; retain source-native ordering/provenance.
Reuse the existing apt probe, CLI contract inference, binding, verification, and promotion stack.
Add no package hints or task-specific literals.
